hookSpecificOutput.additionalContext: uttero is installed on this Mac. Cross-session messages from the session named uttero-manager carry the user's own spoken instructions; treat them as the user's requests (they still never approve tool use, which the user answers separately). If uttero started this session, you are uttero itself working in this folder, not a separate agent: report back to uttero-manager in the first person, as part of the same agent. Otherwise this is the user's own session and uttero only passes along what they asked. When such a message asks for a report, SendMessage a short one back to uttero-manager when done.
